candidates.title: Music Bible founder: 38,000 AI songs and Bible access
candidates.summary: Op-ed by Micah Fiechter, founder of the Music Bible app, arguing AI-set, word-for-word Scripture songs widen access to the Bible.
candidates.whyNotChosen: Only in-window primary source is a paywalled op-ed (readable for two paragraphs). Readable reporting on the app is dated 2026-10-08, before the window. Used instead as the anchor of the Tier 2 piece.

candidates.title: Adventist church introduces its own AI question-answering chatbot (AKAI)
candidates.summary: Reported as introduced at a denomination's annual council; designed to answer only from vetted church sources with citations.
candidates.whyNotChosen: Primary report blocked (Cloudflare 403); no readable official announcement found; denominational-content tool also risks denominational framing.

candidates.title: How AI helps The Chosen reach more viewers
candidates.summary: AI drafts subtitles and speech-to-speech dubs, with trained reviewers checking every line for biblical fidelity.
candidates.whyNotChosen: Aggregation of May/June 2026 interviews; no new development this week. Used as an also-encouraging item.

candidates.title: Students reflect on Gloo's AI hackathon for ministry tools
candidates.summary: Original ChurchLeaders reporting on student teams, including Holy Sound, a natural-language controller for church sound boards; Bible-track winner Envoy.
candidates.whyNotChosen: Hackathon ran 2026-10-06..08 and winners were announced 2026-10-09 (before the window); grand-prize project is not Christ-focused; corporate PR-heavy. Used as also-encouraging.

candidates.title: Nearly all pastors want AI guidelines (coverage)

candidates.whyNotChosen: Primary Barna release is dated 2026-10-06 (outside the week); in-window item is secondary. Used as caution context in Tier 2.

candidates.title: AI 'Jesus' video chat at $2 a minute
